After 33 minutes, Montreal won a corner. The 6-7 tall Drogba made his way to the front of the pack to heading the ball down firmly and clearly. Bernier, though small in stature, was on the floor and managed to get up on one leg. The tiny crowd burst into delight.
Bernier added two more hard, booming headers as Montreal continued to press the case. He reached the second right before the halftime break.
"Our pattern of play changed a little bit," Biello conceded. "I don't know if I instructed guys to go away from the centre, but guys on the bench went away from the centre so right before the whistle Bernier was kind of isolated out front… We made a change right before the whistle hoping somebody would slide away from the centre."
